# AIScan

> AIScan is a free, browser-based security scanner for AI-generated code. Paste code from Cursor, v0, Lovable, Bolt or Claude and it flags common vulnerabilities — SQL injection, hardcoded API keys, missing authentication, XSS, weak hashing, open CORS and more — with the exact line and a fix. The scan runs client-side; nothing is uploaded.

## What AIScan checks (15 security checks)
- SQL injection (user input concatenated into queries)
- Hardcoded secrets and API keys (Stripe, AWS, OpenAI, GitHub, Slack, SendGrid, database URLs, JWTs, private keys)
- Command / code execution (eval, exec, shell_exec on request data)
- Cross-site scripting (raw innerHTML, echoed input)
- Missing authentication on admin and dangerous routes
- Weak password hashing (MD5, SHA1)
- Debug mode and default/blank database credentials
- Wide-open CORS
- Path traversal, SSRF / open redirect
- Insecure deserialization
- Forgeable JWTs (alg:none, verification skipped)
- Insecure cookie flags, CSRF disabled, weak randomness for tokens
